        exact (T i).isOpen_sUnion S (by
          intro s hs
          exact hS s hs i) }
  
  have h_common : ∀ U : Set X,
      @IsOpen X τ U ↔ ∀ i, @IsOpen X (T i) U := by
    intro U
    rfl
  
  have h_max : ∀ σ : TopologicalSpace X,
      (∀ i U, @IsOpen X σ U → @IsOpen X (T i) U) →
      ∀ U, @IsOpen X σ U → @IsOpen X τ U := by
    intro σ hσ U hU
    exact (h_common U).2 (fun i => hσ i U hU)
  
  have h_local :
      (∀ x ∈ A, ∃ U : Set X, x ∈ U ∧
        (∀ i, @IsOpen X (T i) U) ∧ U ⊆ A) →
      @IsOpen X τ A := by
    intro hA
    letI : TopologicalSpace X := τ
    change IsOpen A
    refine isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open.mpr ?_
    intro x hx
    rcases hA x hx with ⟨U, hxU, hU, hUA⟩
    refine ⟨U, hUA, ?_, hxU⟩
    exact (h_common U).2 hU
  
  have h_iff :
      @IsOpen X τ A ↔
        ∀ x ∈ A, ∃ U : Set X, x ∈ U ∧
          (∀ i, @IsOpen X (T i) U) ∧ U ⊆ A := by
    constructor
    · intro hA x hx
      refine ⟨A, hx, ?_, Set.Subset.rfl⟩
      exact (h_common A).1 hA
    · exact h_local
  
  exact ⟨τ, h_common, h_max, h_iff⟩
